verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a payments platform, but the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for event subscription. The closest item is the Issuing feature that can 'send requests to you' for authorization decisions. That is a real-time decisioning flow, an adjacent feature rather than event webhooks, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
